review: I like the look: glowing ghost, a different colour for each stage, hazards I can read at once. But I got stuck too much. In First Steps my run stood in front of two small spike rows for 45 seconds, and in Spike Garden even the expert gave up at a wall. That is not fun in a five-minute break. Saw Mill killed me at the first saw, Ferry Lines dropped me in pits, and Laser Gate killed me in two seconds. Crumble Bridge felt fair and tense. Spring Loaded was pretty but nobody died. Gauntlet is too hard for me.
best: Crumble Bridge is clear, tense and fair, and most players finish it.
worst: Spike Garden leaves even the high-skill player stuck at a wall until the timer ends.
